LESSON: FOOD AND FITNESS NUTRITION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods and
Topic 3.3: Food and fitness Nutrition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Food and fitness Nutrition. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we eat food?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Food and fitness Nutrition means using everyday Kenyan examples
2. describe how Food and fitness Nutrition appears at home, school, or in the environment
3. practise one safe skill connected to Food and fitness Nutrition
4. tell why Food and fitness Nutrition matters for life in Kenya

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: FOOD AND FITNESS NUTRITION
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Food and fitness Nutrition helps you succeed in HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: FOOD AND FITNESS NUTRITION
Food and fitness Nutrition is part of Science learning. Connect every idea to something you can observe.
Use safe examples only. Do not try dangerous experiments without a teacher.
Write definitions in your own words, then add one drawing or real-life example.

PART 1: Explain what Food and fitness Nutrition means using everyday Kenyan examples

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Food and fitness Nutrition means using everyday Kenyan examples. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Food and fitness Nutrition means using everyday Kenyan examples.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Food and fitness Nutrition” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Food and fitness Nutrition means using everyday Kenyan examples. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe how Food and fitness Nutrition appears at home, school, or in the environment

What this means
In this part you learn to describe how Food and fitness Nutrition appears at home, school, or in the environment. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe how Food and fitness Nutrition appears at home, school, or in the environment.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Food and fitness Nutrition matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe how Food and fitness Nutrition appears at home, school, or in the environment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise one safe skill connected to Food and fitness Nutrition

What this means
In this part you learn to practise one safe skill connected to Food and fitness Nutrition. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise one safe skill connected to Food and fitness Nutrition.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Apply: Describe one safe action you can take related to Food and fitness Nutrition this week.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise one safe skill connected to Food and fitness Nutrition. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Tell why Food and fitness Nutrition matters for life in Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to tell why Food and fitness Nutrition matters for life in Kenya. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: tell why Food and fitness Nutrition matters for life in Kenya.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Food and fitness Nutrition” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can tell why Food and fitness Nutrition matters for life in Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Food and fitness Nutrition is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Food and fitness Nutrition” around your school. (skill: explain what Food and fitness Nutrition means using everyday Kenyan examples)

Example 2: Say why Food and fitness Nutrition matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: describe how Food and fitness Nutrition appears at home, school, or in the environment)

Example 3: Describe one safe action you can take related to Food and fitness Nutrition this week. (skill: practise one safe skill connected to Food and fitness Nutrition)

Example 4: Name what you can see/touch about “Food and fitness Nutrition” around your school. (skill: tell why Food and fitness Nutrition matters for life in Kenya)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Food and fitness Nutrition to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Food and fitness Nutrition means using everyday Kenyan examples.
3. Practise this skill: describe how Food and fitness Nutrition appears at home, school, or in the environment.
4. Practise this skill: practise one safe skill connected to Food and fitness Nutrition.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Food and fitness Nutrition from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Food and fitness Nutrition: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Food and fitness Nutrition?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we eat food?
2. Which foods give us (3 lessons) a) mention reasons for eating  learners are guided to classify foods into energy?
3. Which foods protects b) group foods into energy foods using pictures, realia, charts and video our bodies?
4. Which foods build our protective foods,  In groups, learners are guided to identify bodies?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Food and fitness Nutrition means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Food and fitness Nutrition means using everyday Kenyan examples.
5. Be able to: describe how Food and fitness Nutrition appears at home, school, or in the environment.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
